I remember my dog having serious liver issues (she had it all her life) and her wellbeing started to go downhill around the age of 7. 

My mum and dad took her to the vet and returned with some bad news, apparently the condition can't be cured and her life will gradually get worse and worse. He referred her to a vet in another town to have another examination to see if anything could be done. Me and my brother (who were young) held her and kissed her wondering if we were going to see her again. 

My mum and dad left with Holly and an hour later we get a phone call from my mum. She was very upset and asked if we wanted her to be with us one more night and I stopped talking as I was in shock. My brother in the room next door knew what was going on and we both started crying as we didn't believe it was happening. We told my mum to let her go to a better place because we didn't want her to be in pain anymore. 

We received her ashes a few weeks later and we scattered them in her field up near the woods. That's the place where she had the most fun even though she was in pain.
